verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with a public API and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no sandbox, test mode or test keys, and says each API key 'provides full API access.' The 7-day free trial is a billing trial, not an environment isolated from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
